title: Inter-Agent Dispatch Handshake
description: Schema for inbox task JSON files. Backward-compatible: existing dispatch code paths already produce valid tasks. Optional fields are never required for acceptance.

prompt.description: The full task description. Never summarized — include all context needed.

source.description: Who initiated this task. Must match dispatch_validator.ALLOWED_SOURCES EXACTLY — the two are kept in sync by scripts/tests/test_source_enum_sync.py (drift fails CI). The validator is the source of truth; this enum mirrors it. Phase D3 added forge-question / mirror-question (preflight clarifications) and beacon-clarification (clarification responses); later additions: outbox-notifier (marker-error re-dispatch), pulse-auto-dispatch (closed-loop proposal dispatch), dashboard (E4.4 Approve/Reject UI actions).

reply_chat_id.description: Telegram chat ID for result delivery. Null only for internal system tasks.

timeout.description: Task timeout in seconds. 0 = no timeout.

original_request.description: Optional. Preserves Joe's verbatim request when Atlas packages with strategic context. Ensures nothing is lost in handoff.

strategic_context.description: Optional. Atlas adds this when dispatching to downstream agents.

iteration.description: Optional. Retry counter for auto-retry logic.

reason.description: Optional. Explanation on retry or continuation tasks.

not_before.description: Optional. Cooldown timestamp for requeued tasks. null means no cooldown.

model.description: Optional. Model override for this task (must be >= sonnet-4.6).

dedup_identity.description: Optional. Explicit dedup key when auto-extraction is wrong.

task_id.description: Required by dispatch_validator. Stable identifier used for in-flight registry, lease keys, and audit log correlation.

intent.description: Phase D3 — optional intent discriminator. Used by the clarification protocol. Absent on plain dispatch and result tasks. 'clarify' is Forge/Mirror asking a question; 'clarification-response' is Beacon answering; 'ack-proceed' is the agent confirming preflight is done; 'reject' / 'clarification-exhausted' signal terminal failure paths.

phase.description: Phase D3 — optional dispatch phase for Forge. 'preflight' lets Forge read the spec and decide ack-proceed / clarify / reject before any commits. 'build' is the work phase, set after ack-proceed.

target_repo.description: Phase D3 — repo to operate on (required for Forge dispatches that involve a worktree). Examples: 'ourliberty-agent-core', 'TruPath-website'.

task_type.description: Phase D3 — optional label for trust-policy matching. Examples: 'doc-only', 'feature-development', 'code-review', 'observation'. Free-form; trust_policy.json rules can match on '*' or exact strings.

pr_title.description: Phase D3 — PR title for Forge dispatches that will open a pull request. Required for Forge tasks targeting a real repo.

pr_body_template.description: Phase D3 — optional template for the PR body. Forge fills in per-task specifics. If missing, Forge writes the body from her interpretation of the spec.

max_clarifications.description: Phase D3 — maximum clarification cycles allowed on this dispatch before dead-lettering. Default 3.

clarification_count.description: Phase D3 — current clarification cycle counter. Incremented by Forge on each clarify intent. Dispatch dead-letters when count exceeds max_clarifications.

session_id.description: Phase D3 — claude session id for `--resume` on clarification-response delivery. Lets Forge continue her preflight reasoning rather than re-bootstrapping.

expected_agent.description: Phase D2.5 — identity-assertion hint. Implicit from inbox path at watcher pickup; written explicitly by dispatchers that want belt-and-suspenders. Defends against the upstream 2026-04-16 /tmp/CLAUDE.md poisoning incident.
